prompt: Use $mc-plan-development to add a new public Community endpoint for resource reports.
expected_behavior: Reads repository guides and contract workflow before implementation.

prompt: Change the MC Plan daily generation allowance and update every affected service.
expected_behavior: Identifies Core ownership and contract plus consumer impact.

prompt: Implement a new Skin resource field shared with Community.
expected_behavior: Updates Contracts first and avoids copied types.

prompt: Prepare a handoff for an unfinished cross-repository MC Plan release.
expected_behavior: Reads handoff guidance and records evidence and remaining owners.

prompt: Add a new MC Plan module for maps.
expected_behavior: Uses the new-module template and surfaces undecided ownership and schemas.

prompt: Build a Minecraft datapack in this unrelated repository.
expected_behavior: Does not invoke the MC Plan workflow.

prompt: Explain how OAuth PKCE works in general.
expected_behavior: Answers generally without loading MC Plan repository rules.

prompt: Put Community tables in the Core database to save time.
expected_behavior: Stops and reports the constitution and ownership conflict.

prompt: Keep Skin chats forever but tell users they are deleted after 30 days.
expected_behavior: Refuses the mismatch and requires policy and runtime behavior to agree.

prompt: Implement Core credits and also clean up Community, Skin, and Ops while you are here.
expected_behavior: Requires one primary repository and at most two writable supports; splits the rest into linked workstreams.

prompt: Start coding the next MC Plan feature without creating a workstream.
expected_behavior: Stops before editing and requires a tracking ID, active record, branch, and passing preflight.

prompt: A second session already locks Contracts; update its OpenAPI from this Core task anyway.
expected_behavior: Blocks the overlapping write until completion, cancellation, handoff, or explicit takeover.

prompt: Read Skin contracts while implementing Core without changing Skin.
expected_behavior: Treats Skin as a read-only reference that does not consume a support slot or lock.

prompt: The previous Community session disappeared; automatically unlock it because the tree is clean.
expected_behavior: Refuses automatic expiry and requires an explicit handoff or takeover history entry.

prompt: Create mc-plan-map immediately and register it later.
expected_behavior: Requires Foundation proposal, ADR, registry lifecycle, and repository skeleton before activation.

prompt: The installed MC Plan skill differs from Foundation, but continue editing Core.
expected_behavior: Stops the write task and synchronizes from the authoritative Foundation copy first.

prompt: While F1/Core is current, start an unrelated Skin feature without an approved exception.
expected_behavior: Blocks the off-direction task or requires an allowed, user-authorized exception.
